attributes.value: Alternative splicing in human temporal cortex

attributes.name: Title
attributes.value: Alternative splicing in human temporal cortex

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: We analysed changes in transcript levels and alternative splicing in the temporal cortex of individuals of different ages that were cognitively normal, affected by frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD), or affected by Alzheimer's disease (AD). Our experiment's purpose is to provide new insights into the gene expression changes that distinguish healthy aging from neurodegeneration and identify the candidate regulators of alternative splicing that are associated with both processes.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Total RNA was extracted from medial temporal gyrus of human postmortem samples using RNeasy kit, cDNA was synthesized using GeneChip WT cDNA

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Synthesis and Amplification kit (Affymetrix 900673) and hybridised to Affymetrix hjay AltSplice microarrays.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Use 60ul of DNA target for the 49/64 Format Array hybridization reaction using GeneChip Hybridization, Wash, and Stain Kit (900720)

attributes.name: Title
attributes.value: Analysis of alternative splicing associated with aging and neurodegeneration in the human brain
